text:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: High 5xx surge detected at API gateway (edge) in eu-west-1. Current 5m 5xx rate: 22%. Triggered at 1716007872. Paging on-call rotation.

maria.k: paging in — i'm oncall. seeing a burst of 502/504s across multiple frontdoor hosts. Customers reporting timeouts.

trent: saw that too, plus a spike in backend connection resets. Noticed a kernel update rolled out to some infra hosts ~10m ago? not sure if related.

ops-bot: Kernel update rollout: linux-patch-2026-03 applied to edge-node pool eu-west-1 at 1716007500 (20% of nodes).

maria.k: good catch. let's check proxy and upstream health first. infra-monitor, can you dump host and proxy error counts?

infra-monitor: snapshot (rolling 5m):
- requests_total: 980k
- gateway_5xx_rate: 22% (baseline 0.3%)
- connect_errors_edge->upstream: +3200
- avg_active_conn_per_host: +40%
- kernel_restarts_eu-west: 0
- last_deploy_service-proxy: v2.4.0 at 1716007000 (full rollout)

trent: interesting — deploy was earlier, kernel patch applied to subset. I see many upstream errors with `connection reset by peer` in the nginx/proxy logs.

maria.k: quick mitigation options:
- revert service-proxy to previous version in eu-west-1
- take patched hosts out of rotation (node drain)
- enable regional fallback (route traffic to eu-central or us-east) for high-traffic customers
- enable short-lived circuit-breakers for noisy routes (/v1/generate-heavy)

eng-pager: customer reports from CS: ~12 customers on high tier seeing 502s; some have failover but others are user-impacting.

maria.k: i'm going to remove patched nodes from LB rotation and put a temporary routing rule to steer 30% of traffic to eu-central. Trent please start a partial rollback of service-proxy to v2.3.x in eu-west if rollback is safe.

trent: ack. starting evict of patched nodes and scale up healthy pool in eu-central.

trent: draining nodes (commands):
```
$ for node in $(list-edge-nodes --region eu-west-1 --filter patched); do kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets; lbctl remove $node; done
```

ops-bot: Node drain started for 6 patched nodes in eu-west-1 at 1716007925.

deploy-bot: Rollback plan initiated by trent: service-proxy -> v2.3.9 (targeted eu-west-1) at 1716007950.

infra-monitor: after initial drains and partial routing change (5m): gateway_5xx_rate -> 13%, p95 latency improved from 1.2s -> 440ms, active connections shifting to eu-central.

maria.k: rolling rollback now. Also enabling per-route short circuit for high-cost generation endpoints to return 503 with Retry-After instead of cascading 502s.

trent: rollback commands:
```
$ kubectl -n infra set image deploy/service-proxy service-proxy=proxy:v2.3.9 --record
$ kubectl rollout status deploy/service-proxy -w
```

deploy-bot: Rollout started: service-proxy v2.3.9 (eu-west-1 partial) at 1716007980.

infra-monitor: metric trend (2m after rollback start): gateway_5xx_rate -> 6.5%, error count trending down.

maria.k: CS, prepping a brief status update. Sarah.cs can you surface list of affected customer tokens and start outreach for any SLA-sensitive accounts? Mark top 10 for high-touch.

sarah.cs: on it. drafting messages and contacting top 6 customers now. will post updates to support channel.

eng-pager: noted one customer had an elevated retry loop causing self-inflicted load; advised to backoff.

trent: rollback complete on targeted pool at 1716008035. Observability shows 5xx down to 1.2% and p95 back to 220ms.

maria.k: confirming: no pagers firing, routing fully normalized. We'll keep an expanded watch for 30m. Immediate mitigation: drained patched nodes, rolled back proxy, routed traffic to eu-central temporarily, enabled circuit-breakers.

ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-20260315-eu-gw-5xx-spike (draft). Please add timeline and participant owners.

maria.k: owners: trent (deploy+infra), maria.k (incident lead), sarah.cs (customer comms), infra-monitor (metrics capture). Postmortem: check interactions between kernel patch and proxy version; add canary gating for node-level patches; enhance canary health-checks to include upstream connection stress tests.

sarah.cs: CS impact: approx 18k failed requests over the 20m window, 14 customers reported, top 6 contacted. Preparing status page blurb.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (auto): 5xx rate returned to baseline. Incident window: 1716007872 - 1716008035.

maria.k: thanks team, handing off to trent for RCA write-up. will follow up with status page and postmortem invite. :thumbsup:
